title: Project Qyrix
features:
-- Open Sourced --

🎮 Autofarm

Auto Tap
-    Automatically taps 

Auto Rebirth
-    Automatically buys rebirths

Rebirth Amount Selector
-    Choose how many rebirths happen per cycle

Auto Collect Orbs
-    Automatically collects all orbs on the map

Auto Collect Mini Chests
-    Automatically opens mini chests around the map

🥚 Eggs

Egg Selector
-    Choose which egg to open from a dropdown list

Auto Open Eggs
-    Continuously opens the selected egg

Remove Egg Animation
-    Disables egg hatching animations for faster openings

🐾 Crafting

Owned Pet List
-    Displays all pets you currently own

Pet Selection
-    Select which pets to use for crafting

Golden Craft Amount
-    Choose how many pets are used per craft

Auto Craft Golden Pets
-    Automatically crafts selected pets into golden versions

Refresh Pet List
-    Updates your pet list without restarting the script
